stops.title: Fɔ Sɛt Ɔp
stops.caption: Rijɔn fɔs, dɛn branch.
stops.speech: Fɔ sɛt ɔp de stat wit rijɔn, dɛn di branch dɛn insay dɛn, bikɔs ɛvri mɛmba ɛn ɛvri grup bilɔng to wan branch.

stops.title: Yu Fɔs Branch
stops.caption: Nem am, put am, lid am.
stops.speech: Gi di branch wan nem, wan siti ɛn sɛvis skɛjul, dɛn gi in pasto. Mɛmba dɛn kin kam afta dat.
